title: CXO weekly focus — compact scratchpad
content:
Quick morning scratchpad — compact view for the week (notes to self).

Context: prepping for leadership sync, SRE checkpoint, and customer handoff for Dedicated pilot slot. Keep this short; use as handoff if I need to step out.

Top 3 for the week (what moves the needle):
1) Dedicated pilot: finalize SLOs + commercial terms with Acme Health (legal redlines done?) — aim to sign by Fri.
   - Key asks: guaranteed 99.9% p99 latency for 2x baseline; monthly committed throughput; audit window for logs.
   - Blockers: security review (Helen) incomplete; encryption KMS questions (sec).
   - Next: call with solutions eng Tuesday 10:30 to confirm deployment topology and fallback plan.
2) Platform reliability: shipping autoscaling backfill for large-seq tails (SRE / serving-runtime).
   - Metrics to watch: P95, P99, tail queue length, token-per-second throughput vs baseline.
   - Rollout rule: canary 10% traffic for 48h, abort if p99 > baseline + 30ms or error rate > 0.25%.
3) Go-to-market: refine Dedicated pricing model for mid-market bucket — run sensitivity with finance.
   - Deliverable: pricing model slidedeck for BD by Thursday.

Daily timebox (my default):
- 08:00–08:30: inbox triage + quick metric check (dashboards below).
- 08:30–09:15: prep for leadership sync (review team notes).
- 09:30–10:30: leadership sync (agenda below).
- 10:30–11:00: solutions eng sync re: Acme Health (Tuesday).
- 11:15–12:00: tactical follow-ups (legal, finance).
- 13:00–15:00: deep work block (pricing model / slide deck).
- 15:00–16:00: SRE/serving-runtime standup 
- 16:00–17:00: buffer / adhoc 

Leadership sync — quick agenda (keep tight):
- 1) 3 bullets: what shipped / what’s stuck / blocking asks (each leader 2 min).
- 2) Platform health snapshot (SRE): current p95/p99, incidents open, capacity headroom.
- 3) Sales ops: Dedicated pilot pipeline (names), next steps for Acme.
- 4) Hiring/time-sensitive asks (any approvals needed).
- 5) Decision: pricing anchor for mid-market or defer to Friday review.

Meeting prep notes (things to call out):
- SRE: confirm canary abort thresholds spelled out — don’t let ambiguity.
- Legal: ask for exact redline text on data retention + audit access. If they push on retention windows, consider offering a short-term SOC-like compromise (90 days) while we iterate.
- Solutions eng: need explicit rollback sequence and expected cost delta for fallbacks (quantify).

Follow-ups (action list — quick):
- [ ] Helen (security): send KMS decision doc by Wed COB (owner: Helen)
- [ ] Priya (legal): finalize Acme contract redlines — due Thu EOD (owner: Priya)
- [ ] SRE team: post canary runbook in confluence, link in exec channel (owner: Ben)
- [ ] Finance: run 3-tier pricing sensitivity for Dedicated for 6, 12, 24 month commits (owner: Lina)
- [ ] Solutions Eng: confirm topology diagram and fallback model for Acme (owner: Grace)

Dashboards & quick checks (links I usually open):
- Platform health: /dashboards/infra/platform-health (p95/p99/cpu/gpu utilization)
- Cost per token: /dashboards/cost/unit-economics (compare week-over-week)
- Dedicated queue: /dashboards/capacity/dedicated-queues
- Active incidents: /incidents/active

Escalation thresholds (for my immediate attention):
- P99 increases > 30ms above baseline for > 30 minutes and error rate > 0.25%
- Any customer-facing outage for Dedicated pilots > 5 minutes
- Billing anomalies: charge spikes > 20% vs rolling 7-day avg

Notes to self for handoff (if I step out):
- If legal delays Acme, offer a 30-day technical pilot with restricted audit access under NDA (keeps momentum while finalizing contract).
- If autoscaling canary shows cost > expected, pause rollout and ask SRE for micro-optimizations (kv-cache, batch config).
- Ask BD to get a written note from Acme about timeline commitments — helps prioritize infra work.

Parking lot / later this week:
- Exec comms draft for Dedicated launch (outline audience + TL;DR).
- Quick whitepaper: cost/perf tradeoffs for quantized model variants (for solutions eng).
- Headcount ask: one more infra SRE contractor for Q2 + ops lead for Dedicated.

Random quick reminders (personal):
- Call with mom Friday evening.
- Bring printed Acme SOW to Friday meeting.

Short feedback log (what I noticed this week):
- Support tickets: repeat issue around model warmup — ask runtime team for a short-term mitigation (longer warmup + prefetch).
- Docs: canary runbook is too wordy; insist on a TL;DR checklist at top.

If I need to hand this off mid-day: copy this doc into slack #exec-ops with subject "handoff: Marcus — key asks" and tag Helen / Priya / Grace.

End of compact scratchpad. Keep it terse.

— Marcus
